name: Spinal Dysraphism - Occult
definition: Spectrum of closed congenital spinal malformations, sometimes associated with tethered cord, lipoma, dermal sinus or cutaneous stigmata.

investigations.principle: MRI lumbosacral spine is used when high-risk cutaneous or neurological features are present.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Not every sacral dimple requires MRI; risk stratification is important.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Congenital neuro-spinal phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Spectrum of closed congenital spinal malformations, sometimes associated with tethered cord, lipoma, dermal sinus or cutaneous stigmata.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
